Movistar Riders is a Spanish esports organization founded in 2017. In January 2024 it was announced that the organization had been acquired by OverActive Media as part of a merger between KOI, Movistar Riders, and MAD Lions.

  • January 10th - Movistar Riders is founded with a lineup consisting of HITBOX, littlesataNN, vity and JACKW. [1][2]
  • January 20th - Movistar Riders sign Zorrele to finalize their lineup. [3]
  • March 30th - Movistar Riders sign Nevermind, with their former squad becoming Movistar Riders Blue. Additionally, they sign Cr0n0s as coach. [4][5]
  • July 17th - Movistar Riders part ways with their roster. [6]
  • July 24th - Movistar Riders sign a new lineup consisting of dragunov, meisoN, ALEX, donQ, mopoz and Spanisfury, the latter as coach. [7]
  • December 29th - Movistar Riders part ways with Spanisfury. [8]
  • February 1st - Movistar Riders sign kam1kaze as coach. [9]
  • April 13th - Movistar Riders part ways with ALEX. [10]
  • May 16th - Movistar Riders sign MUTiRiS to complete their lineup. [11]
  • July 18th - Movistar Riders part ways with kam1kaze. [12]
  • July 19th - Movistar Riders bench dragunov, meisoN, donQ and MUTiRiS as they sign mixwell, loWel, SOKER and ALEX. [13][14]
  • August 21st - meisoN and donQ are acquired by Dragons Esports Club. [15]
  • August 31st - dragunov is acquired by MAD Lions. [16]
  • September 3rd - MUTiRiS is acquired by Giants Gaming. [17]
  • November 6th - Movistar Riders sign Pulgago as an analyst. [18]
  • January 17th - Movistar Riders sign bladE as coach. [19]
  • April 5th - loWel is acquired by HellRaisers. [20]
  • April 4th - Movistar Riders sign DeathZz. [21]
  • July 2nd - Movistar Riders part ways with mixwell and sign EasTor as his replacement. [22]
  • October 18th - Movistar Riders bench SOKER and DeathZz. [23][24]
  • October 19th - Movistar Riders re-acquire loWel from Hell Raisers and sign Steel. [25]
  • October 25th - Movistar Riders part ways with Pulgago. [26]
  • November 29th - Movistar Riders sign Hepa as an analyst. [27]
  • December 23rd - Movistar Riders release SOKER. [28]
  • January 13th - Movistar Riders loan DeathZz to Wygers. [29]
  • April 29th - Movistar Riders release DeathZz. [30]
  • July 16th - Movistar Riders part ways with Hepa. [31]
  • July 28th - Movistar Riders bench EasTor. [32]
  • August 6th - Movistar Riders bench loWel and sign larsen and shokz. [33]
  • August 25th - EasTor is acquired by OFFSET Esports. [34]
  • September 11th - Movistar Riders part ways with loWel as he retires from professional Counter-Strike: Global Offensive. [35]
  • January 12th - Movistar Riders bench larsen. [36]
  • January 27th - Movistar Riders release larsen upon the expiration of his contract. [37]
  • February 2nd - Movistar Riders sign smooya. [38]
  • July 31st - Movistar Riders bench steel and part ways with shokz. [39]
  • August 12th - Movistar Riders bench smooya and sign DeathZz, SunPayus, and dav1g. Additionally, they sign repk3ys as an analyst. [40]
  • October 10th - Movistar Riders release steel while smooya is acquired by Fnatic. [41]
  • August 11th - Movistar Riders part ways with SunPayus. [42]
  • August 12th - Movistar Riders sign Martinez. [43]
  • October 21st - Movistar Riders part ways with DeathZz and acquire sausol from Partizan Esports. [44][45]
  • July 3rd - Movistar Riders part ways with sausol. [46]
  • July 5th - Movistar Riders acquire JUST from SAW. [47]
  • July 21st - Movistar Riders bench dav1g and sign adamS. [48][49]
  • November 3rd - alex is acquired by Ninjas in Pyjamas. [50]
  • November 6th - Movistar Riders reinstate dav1g to the starting lineup. [51]
  • December 4th - Martinez is acquired by 9z Team. [52]
  • December 14th - Movistar Riders part ways with bladE. [53]
  • December 26th - Movistar Riders part ways with repk3ys. [54]
  • January 4th - Movistar Riders' lineup and personnel transfer to KOI as part of an acquisition and merger by OverActive Media. [55]
